name: Usodere!
source:
Since the main character lost his parents when he was a kid, he now lives alone. One day, his grand-father, a man of property, tells him to move to his house. He is confused at first, but he decides to start his new life. He also transfers to a new school, but he is actually one and only male student. Every girl is interested in him because they think he will inherit his grand-father's property sooner or later... Like this, a battle for him starts...

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
主人公年幼时失去双亲，如今独自生活。一天，身为富豪的祖父让他搬到自己家里。主人公起初有些困惑，最终还是决定开始新生活。他也转入一所新学校，而校内竟只有他一个男生。所有女孩都对他很感兴趣，因为她们认为他迟早会继承祖父的财产…就这样，一场围绕他的争夺战开始了…

[摘自ErogeShop]
